blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—National University continued its dominance in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament, easing past Adamson, 79-43, on Saturday at Blue Eagles Gym. The Bulldogs barely broke a sweat en route to a 6-2 record, tying University of the Philippines atop the standings. “I give credit to my players; we executed our game plan from start to finish,” NU coach Jeff Napa said. “They’re capable. We just had to think properly and we just went back to being disciplined on both offense and defense.” The Bulldogs pulled away after a tight […]...
